This hollow, meat-filled pumpkin is a local specialty of Kakariko Village.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat-Stuffed Pumpkins can be [[Cooking|Cooked]] by combining a [[Fortified Pumpkin]] with any type of [[Meat]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by adding a third ingredient with an effect other than tough. By eating them, some of [[Link]]s's [[Heart]]s will be restored. These [[Meal]]s are a specialty of [[Kakariko Village]]. After completing [[Koko]]'s first two quests, Link can speak to her again to find that she wants to make [[Dorian|her father's]] favorite meal, Tough Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin.{{Cite|What should Koko make now... {{Big|OH!}} Koko will make Father's favorite! {{Color BotW|Blue|Tough meat-stuffed pumpkin}}!|Koko|BotW}} Unfortunately, while going over the recipe, Koko realizes that she doesn't have any [[Raw Meat]].{{Cite|Let's see... The ingredients are... {{Color BotW|Blue|fortified pumpkin}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|raw meat}}. Hrm? ...{{Color BotW|Blue|Raw meat}}? {{Big|OH, NO!!}} Koko is out of {{Color BotW|Blue|raw meat}}...|Koko|BotW}} This begins the [[Side Quest]] "[[Koko Cuisine]]". Link can bring her Raw Meat, which Koko will be thankful for{{Cite|Is this...{{Big|raw meat?!}} Are you sure about this? Really? Thank you so much! Koko means it! Stay right there for a second!|Koko|BotW}} After making it, Koko will be pleased with the result, saying it is just like her mother made and giving some to Link as a reward.{{Cite|Mmm! What a scrumptious smell! Oh, and that savory meat pairs SO well with the sweetness of the pumpkin! This is just how Mother made it! Here, have some! It's so good!|Koko|BotW}} Only one variation of Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin exists: * '''Tough Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This hollow, meat-filled fortified pumpkin is a local specialty or Kakariko Village.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using the default recipe. Eating these pumpkins will increase Link's [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Trivia== * An unused icon and description for Meat-Stuffed Pumpkins exist within the files of {{AoC}}.{{Cite Internal|quote= This hollow, meat-filled fortified pumpkin is a local specialty of Kakariko Village. |game= AoC |system= Nintendo Switch |version= 1.0.0 |country= United States}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Unused icon for a Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Steamed Meat }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
